# YAML workflows and scheduling

Workflows chain search, download, inference and export steps, from a YAML file or in Python, and can be scheduled. They are
separate from the built-in pipelines above.

**Explained in:** [YAML workflows](../../pipelines/yaml-workflows.md)

This page documents **14 public classes and functions** in 6 modules.

## `pygeovision.pipelines.steps`

Pipeline step definitions.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `StepError` | class | A step cannot do what it was asked to. Deterministic, so the orchestrator does not retry it. |
| `Step` | class |  |
| `SearchStep` | class | ``client.search(**params)``; an empty result is a failure (every later step needs scenes). |
| `DownloadStep` | class | ``client.download(search_results, **params)``; fails unless at least one scene arrived. |
| `InferStep` | class | Tiled inference of *your trained* model over each downloaded scene. |
| `ExportStep` | class | Vectorise each prediction raster and write it as ``format`` (geojson \| gpkg \| shp \| kml). |
